Class GtCsvExportDefs

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.exportcsv.GtCsvExportDefs
public final class GtCsvExportDefs extends Object
Language dependent column headers and transaction type words for the Grafioschtrader transaction CSV export.

These labels are a wire format, not UI text. The exported CSV files must be re-importable through the CSV transaction import. The import maps the CSV column headers against the Grafioschtrader import templates csv_base-csv-20000101-de|en.tmpl in grafioschtrader-server/src/test/resources/testdata/import_template/grafioschtrader. Those templates bind the transaction properties to exactly these header texts and type words. For this reason the labels are deliberately not placed in messages.properties: a harmless looking translation edit there would silently break the column mapping. Any change to a label here requires the same change in the corresponding template files; the round-trip test TransactionCsvExportRoundTripTest fails when generator and templates drift apart.

Constraints imposed by the CSV import engine (TemplateConfigurationAndStateCsv / GenericTransactionImportCSV):

  • Header texts must match the template's column mapping byte for byte (only surrounding whitespace is stripped).
  • The transaction type words are whole-field values mapped via the template's transType= configuration; every word must map to exactly one transaction type.
  • Numbers are always printed with Swiss separators (apostrophe grouping, dot decimal) and the templates declare overRuleSeparators=All<'|.>, making the import independent of the importing user's locale.
  • Rows sharing the same non-zero Order value within one calendar day are treated as one logical transaction; the export uses this to pair the two sides of a same-portfolio cash transfer.
  • Margin open/close rows carry MARGIN_MARKER in the Marker column; the template's ignoreLineByFieldValue=sf1||MARGIN makes the import skip them (securityRisk and the close-to-open link cannot be reconstructed). FINANCE_COST rows are exported without the marker: the import links them to the open margin position automatically or fails the single row visibly.

  • Method Details

    • forLocale

      public static GtCsvExportDefs.Labels forLocale(Locale locale)
      Returns the label set for the given locale. German gets the German headers; every other language falls back to English, mirroring the two languages supported by the shipped import templates.

    • getTransactionTypeWord

      public static String getTransactionTypeWord(TransactionType transactionType, GtCsvExportDefs.Labels labels)
      Returns the localized transaction type word written to the Transaction column. Every word maps back to the same transaction type through the template's transType= configuration.
      Parameters:
      transactionType - the persisted transaction type
      labels - the language dependent label set
      Returns:
      whole-field value identifying the transaction type
